d:
a colossal automaton species with a deep charcoal gray body and pale cream-colored facial plating. The form is bulkier than the base state, featuring massive, square shoulders and three sharp silver claws on each hand. A large, glowing red gemstone is centered in the chest, and the head retains a single yellow glowing eye-slit. It has no tail and no wings.
BODY COLOR: deep charcoal gray
